test_cases.title: Verify initial state and secure storage
steps: Activate the initial state
Check if the requirements are stored in a secure manner
Assert that the storage is permanent
expected: Requirements stored securely and permanently

test_cases.title: Test change management
steps: Initiate change management process
Associate change with developer identification
Assert that the change is recorded and linked to the developer
Check if the system transitions to a change management state
expected: Change managed and associated correctly

test_cases.title: Scalability test for handling requirements
steps: Add a large number of requirements
Assert that the system can handle the new requirements without performance degradation
Check if the system maintains scalability
expected: System scales to support thousands of requirements without issues

test_cases.title: Verify lightweight installation method
steps: Execute the lightweight installation method
Assert that the system installs without errors
Check if the installation process is indeed lightweight
expected: System installs successfully using the lightweight method

test_cases.title: Verify secure storage after change
steps: Simulate a requirement change
Assert that the system transitions to a change management state
Check if the new requirement is stored securely and separately from the old one
expected: New requirement stored securely without affecting existing requirements

test_cases.title: Verify handling of multiple developers
steps: Assign multiple developers to the requirements
Assert that each developer is linked to their respective requirements
Check if the system maintains individual tracking for each developer
expected: Each developer is correctly associated with their requirements

test_cases.title: Scalability test with multiple developers
preconditions: Requirements stored, managed, and multiple developers assigned
steps: Simulate adding more developers
Assert that the system can scale with the increase in developers
Check if the system maintains individual tracking and scalability for each developer
expected: System scales and maintains tracking and scalability with additional developers

test_cases.title: Verify system behavior at boundary conditions
steps: Reduce the number of requirements to the minimum
Assert that the system still manages and stores requirements securely
Simulate a large number of changes
Assert that the system can handle and manage changes efficiently
expected: System maintains secure storage and efficient change management at boundary conditions

test_cases.title: Verify system behavior with incorrect developer assignments
steps: Assign an incorrect developer to a requirement
Assert that the system detects the error and prompts for correct assignment
Check if the system maintains secure storage and correct tracking after correction
expected: System detects and corrects incorrect developer assignments while maintaining secure storage

test_cases.title: Verify system behavior with maximum load
steps: Simulate the maximum number of requirements and developers
Assert that the system maintains scalability and secure storage under maximum load
Check if the system does not crash or lose data
expected: System maintains scalability and secure storage at maximum load
